=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2789-2823 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: After a successful dispatch, `_mt_release` clears the seed with `[ "${released}" -eq 0 ] || _MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=""` and the lease tick lists the runs again, assuming the new `Internal: AI Review & Autofix [pr:<n>]` run is already visible; but `gh workflow run` returns 204 with no run id, GitHub creates the run asynchronously, and `_mt_dispatch_review` (lines 1484-1507 / 1500-1503) does not confirm the run is visible, so `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` can return 1 and the holder is revoked with `revoked_idle` (gemini also names `revoked_no_head_gate`) plus a hard `skip=<pr>:<head>:revoked_idle` entry.
  WHY: A holder whose review was just dispatched gets parked until its head changes, which is the failure issue #9983 / G2 is meant to prevent; test_a_review_dispatched_by_the_release_pass_keeps_the_holder cannot catch it because tests/merge_lease_fake_gh.py `dispatch_adds_run` adds the run at the moment of dispatch. All reviewers rated it MAJOR; confidence ranged from 3 to 4.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2713-2823 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: After a successful dispatch, `_mt_release` throws away the run listing it already fetched and seeded (lines 2713-2727, 2819-2823), which forces a full second `_mt_inflight_review_branches` pass in the following tick (`_mt_merge_lease_tick` ~2006-2045, `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` ~2302-2337).
  WHY: This breaks the issue's budget of at most one listing pass per tick on the dispatch path, adding about ten `actions/runs?status=<s>` reads. All three rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash disputes it as the deliberate, documented fix for stale dispatch data. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 agrees the extra listing is real but files it under the race finding above, whose fix removes it.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick / _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The tick functions reset `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED`, `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE` and `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_JSON` at the start of every run, which discards any listing seeded by `_mt_release`.
  WHY: The reviewer says this forces a new listing pass on every poll interval and breaks the §14 API budget (BLOCKER). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash both say this is a misread: lines 1885-1889 reset the cache only when `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED` is not "1", and `_mt_merge_lease_tick_multi` does not reset it at all.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:527-531 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The CI check `review / gate` (run 45143233106) failed while resolving the support ref / protected-main fallback: `GH_API_RETRY outcome=gave_up kind=primary bucket=core status=403 ... endpoint=repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/main`, then exit code 75.
  WHY: This is a transient API or rate-limit failure in a workflow this PR does not change; it needs a re-run, not a code change. All three rated it NIT.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_release, line 2822 `[ "${released}" -eq 0 ] || _MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED=""` (dispatch at line 2789, `release_released_prs` at line 2795; consumers: idle branches `1) tick_reason="revoked_idle"` / `1) tm_reason="revoked_idle"`) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Clearing the seed assumes the just-dispatched `Internal: AI Review & Autofix [pr:<n>]` run already appears in `actions/runs?status=queued`. workflow_dispatch returns 204 with no run id and creates the run after it responds, so `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active` can return 1, and the holder is revoked with `revoked_idle` and a hard `skip=<pr>:<head>:revoked_idle` entry.
  WHY: The holder stays parked, which is the failure G2 is meant to prevent. The second listing also costs API calls on every tick that dispatches. tests/merge_lease_fake_gh.py adds the run synchronously, so the new test cannot catch this.
  SUGGESTED_FIX: In both idle and both no_head_gate branches, treat a holder found in `" ${release_released_prs:-} "` as holder_runs_active before calling `_mt_lease_pr_runs_active`, and drop the seed clear at line 2822 (~8 lines, HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3).
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (not changed by this PR), CI check `review / gate`, run 45143233106, support-ref resolution step | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `GH_API_RETRY outcome=gave_up kind=primary bucket=core status=403 ... endpoint=repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/main`, then `Process completed with exit code 75`. This is rate-limit exhaustion.
  WHY: The gate stops before review runs. It needs a re-run, not a code change.
- Note: the reviewer rejects the pass-1 claim that `_mt_merge_lease_tick` always throws away the seeded cache. Lines 1885-1889 reset it only when `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED` is not "1".
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick and _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Clearing the cache at the start of each tick forces redundant listing passes, which breaks the API budget (§14).
  WHY: The tick functions reset `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED`, `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_STATE` and `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_JSON` on every run, which discards the listing seeded by `_mt_release`.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_merge_lease_tick / _mt_merge_lease_tick_multi and _mt_release | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Because dispatch is asynchronous, the run may not be visible yet, which creates a race in the revocation logic.
  WHY: `gh workflow run` returns 204 before the run is visible, so a holder released by this pass can be revoked with `revoked_idle` or `revoked_no_head_gate` and given a hard skip entry.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:_mt_release | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: There is an unnecessary second listing pass after a review dispatch.
  WHY: Clearing `_MT_LEASE_RUNS_SEEDED` breaks the rule of at most one listing pass per tick.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
